pwsbuilder May 31, 2017

Meet the Artist Barbara Quinn-Grasso as the summer of free art demos begins on Saturday, June 10 from 2 to 4 PM at the Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists. Come and learn how to use pastel in this free introduction with all the materials you need, including aprons, provided. Learn about this magical medium, and how to use it safely and with minimal dust. Barbara teaches a technique for light application, the appropriate uses of hard and soft pastels, the qualities of a variety of surfaces, and tips on how to present finished work. Each person has an opportunity to create at least one small pastel.

The Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists (source page unavailable) is located at 551 Main Street (Rte. 28) in Harwich Port (508-432-1012). Paintings by Barbara as well as those of 23 other artists are available for sale at the gallery which is now open seven days a week. Free parking is available across the street from the gallery.
